finding.title: Attachment image previews bypass bounded image signature and dimension validation
finding.description: An authenticated attachment/read result with declared image/png is converted directly to a Blob and assigned to img without mediaMime. The encoded attachment limit and CSS display dimensions do not bound intrinsic decoded pixels.
finding.reproduction: A 24-byte PNG header declaring 65535 by 65535 pixels, delivered by a controlled attachment/read response, caused the unchanged component to render img src=blob:preview. The new assertion expecting no img failed. No image decoder, image loading, actual large image, credentials or remote service was used.

constraints: Reuse shared mediaBytes and mediaMime without editing shared helper.
Rejected/unsupported image previews preserve bounded raw download, and empty ordinary files remain supported.
Keep authentication suspension/draft behavior and stale Api/attachment identity ownership fenced.
Only component, focused attachment tests and approved app-lifecycle fixture metadata may change.
limitations: Static review and jsdom controlled response only; no real image decoding or browser visual acceptance.
Separate repair-stage issue; no new clean audit round credit.
